name: Manyokko ☆ Makorin ~Boku mo Mahou Shoujo!?~
original_name: まにょっこ☆まこりん～僕も魔法少女！？～
source:
Makoto, the protagonist, was sent to stay with his cousin Minoru during summer vacation while his parents went on a honeymoon.
One day, he discovered that Minoru was a manyokko—someone with magical abilities.

"So you're… one of those 'gifted' people too, huh?"

As it turned out, Makoto himself also harbored strong magical potential.
He became acquainted with Minoru's friend, Kyou, and for a while, it seemed like his days would be filled with joy.
But then, one day, Minoru suddenly stopped coming home.

To find him, Makoto and Kyou decided to visit Natsuki at the Kanda Dojo.
There, they met a boy named Chisato, who admired Kyou but seemed to have a competitive streak toward Natsuki.
Through casual conversation, Makoto and Chisato quickly became friends.

As they talked, Makoto sensed that Chisato also possessed extraordinary magical power.
Meanwhile, Kyou managed to track down Minoru, but something was off… Minoru transformed and attacked.
Facing Minoru, Kyou struggled to fight back and was drained of so much magical energy that he couldn't even maintain his transformation.
Seeing Kyou in such a state, Chisato blurted out,

"I'll fight in your place! For… for Kyou's sake!"

Makoto was struck by Chisato's determination and wished he could muster that kind of courage himself.
Just then, he faintly heard someone calling out. Following the voice, he arrived at a place where…

"Mugyuu! That hurts! Don't step on me, kero!"

There sat a plump, talking frog named Kaerotta.
Kaerotta explained that its contract with Minoru had been forcibly broken. After sizing up Makoto, it said,

"Hey, kid, wanna make a contract with me, kero?"

Meanwhile, in the shadows Shion watched the manyokko with a suspicious gaze. What were his intentions…?

A new, turbulent tale of manyokko was about to begin.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ007619.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
“translation”: “主人公真琴在暑假期间被父母送去表弟实的家中暂住，而父母则去度蜜月了。
某天，他发现实是一名魔女——拥有魔法能力的人。

”原来你也是……'天赋异禀'的人啊。“

事实证明，真琴自身也蕴藏着强大的魔力潜能。
他认识了实的朋友京，一时间，他的日子似乎充满了欢乐。
然而有一天，实突然不再回家了。

为了寻找实，真琴和京决定去神田道场找夏树。
在那里，他们遇到了一个名叫千里的男孩，他崇拜京，但似乎对夏树有一种竞争意识。
通过闲聊，真琴和千里很快就成了朋友。

交谈中，真琴察觉到千里也拥有非凡的魔力。
与此同时，京设法找到了实，但有些不对劲……实变身并发动了攻击。
面对实，京奋力抵抗，却被吸走了大量魔力，甚至无法维持变身。
看到京这副模样，千里脱口而出：

”我来替你战斗！为了……为了京！“

真琴被千里的决心所打动，希望自己也能鼓起那样的勇气。
就在这时，他隐约听到有人在呼唤。循着声音，他来到了一个地方……

”姆啾！好痛！不要踩我，呱！“

那里坐着一只圆滚滚的会说话的青蛙，名叫呱太。
呱太解释说它与实的契约被强制解除了。它打量了真琴一番后说道：

”嘿，小子，想和我签订契约吗，呱？“

与此同时，在暗处，紫苑用怀疑的目光注视着魔女们。他的意图是什么……？

一段全新的、波澜壮阔的魔女物语即将展开。
